title: Austin Artists Get Relief, Transit Equity Focus
summary:
*   **Emergency Aid for Artists:** Approved an Austin Music Disaster Relief Fund and expanded the Creative Space Assistance Program to provide urgent grants to local artists affected by the pandemic, with a focus on quick and equitable distribution.
*   **Equitable Transit Investments:** Reaffirmed commitment to ensure the Project Connect mass transit system serves all income levels and communities of color, explicitly addressing potential gentrification with proactive anti-displacement strategies.
*   **Neighborhood Mobility Upgrades:** Allocated "quarter-cent" funds for numerous local infrastructure projects across the city, including new sidewalks, pedestrian safety beacons, and the removal of a long-standing traffic island ("pork chop") to improve connectivity.

agenda_items.lead_dept: Gov't That Works For All - Financial Services
agenda_items.description: Approve a resolution directing staff to establish a fund within the proposed Fiscal Year 2020-2021 budget to address displacement related to transit infrastructure investments.
Approve a resolution initiating an amendment to the East 11th Street Neighborhood Conservation Combining District to enable zoning that supports Urban Renewal Agency properties.

Approve a resolution directing the City Manager to use the Creative Spaces Assistance Program funding, or such other funds as may be available, to assist Austin artists with necessities such as rent during the duration of the COVID-19 emergency.
